definitions.explanation: A statement that makes something clear.

examples.japanese: {説明|せつめい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}いて→聞く：00483_kiku⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{使|つか}い{方|かた}→使い方：07797_tsukaikata⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{説明|せつめい}⟦します→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I'll explain how to use it.

examples.japanese: {説明|せつめい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{分|わ}かりやすかった→わかりやすい：09582_wakariyasui⟧。
examples.english: The explanation was easy to understand.

notes:
{説明|せつめい} means explanation or description. As a verbal noun, it forms {説明|せつめい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to explain).

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive)
- No standard intransitive pair
- Pattern: [noun]⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{説明|せつめい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {説明|せつめい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to explain
- {説明|せつめい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}く→聞く：00483_kiku⟧: to listen to an explanation
- {説明|せつめい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧: to receive an explanation
- ～⟦について→〜について：03103_nitsuite⟧{説明|せつめい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to explain about ~

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{説明書|せつめいしょ}→説明書：19368_setsumeisho⟧: instruction manual
- ⟦{説明会|せつめいかい}→説明会：03087_setsumeikai⟧: information session, briefing
- ⟦{自己|じこ}→自己：23357_jiko⟧{説明|せつめい}: self-explanation

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{解説|かいせつ}→解説：00138_kaisetsu⟧: commentary, detailed explanation
- ⟦{紹介|しょうかい}→紹介：01432_shoukai⟧: introduction
- ⟦{案内|あんない}→案内：01291_annai⟧: guidance, information

The phrase {説明|せつめい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{足|た}りない→足りる：01209_tariru⟧ (explanation is insufficient) is common for expressing that something wasn't explained well enough.
